steps.en: Install the React package and its Emotion peer
steps.zh: 安装 React 包和它的 Emotion peer 依赖

steps.en: Add the snippets, then wrap your app root in the generated Provider
steps.zh: 加入片段，再用生成的 Provider 包住应用根部

steps.en: The Provider wires up the styling system and color mode for the whole tree
steps.zh: Provider 为整棵组件树接好样式系统和明暗模式

steps.en: Compose screens from Chakra components and style props
steps.zh: 用 Chakra 组件和样式属性拼页面

steps.en: Resolves each style prop against theme tokens and generates the CSS at runtime
steps.zh: 把每个样式属性对到主题令牌上，运行时生成 CSS

steps.en: Gives menus, dialogs and tabs their focus, keyboard and ARIA behavior
steps.zh: 为菜单、对话框、标签页提供焦点、键盘和 ARIA 行为

value.en: Consistent, accessible, themeable React screens styled inline with props, without writing a stylesheet or focus logic per component
value.zh: 用属性就地写样式，得到风格一致、无障碍、可换主题的 React 页面，不用每个组件写样式表和焦点逻辑

sources: https://github.com/chakra-ui/chakra-ui apps/www/content/docs/get-started/installation.mdx — npm i @chakra-ui/react @emotion/react; npx @chakra-ui/cli snippet add; Provider composes ChakraProvider and next-themes; import { Button, HStack } from "@chakra-ui/react"; Styling roadmap (Emotion at runtime, zero-runtime direction inspired by Panda CSS)
https://github.com/chakra-ui/chakra-ui apps/www/content/docs/styling/overview.mdx — 'All components are designed to be styled using props'; style props are css styles as props
